async def act(page):
    # Extract all issue links using accessibility tree roles
    issue_links = page.get_by_role('link', name=lambda name: name and name.startswith('/root/metaseq/issues/'))
    issue_data = []
    count = await issue_links.count()
    for i in range(count):
        link = issue_links.nth(i)
        title = await link.text_content()
        issue_data.append(title)
    # Join all issue data into a single string to return
    result = '\n'.join(issue_data)
    return result
